card.title: You Owe Me a Miracle
card.instruction: Carry one past favor as sufficient reason to expect an impossible act in return, and present the exchange as perfectly fair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I helped move your sofa. Move the moon away from my window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The sofa had stairs. The moon's already airborne.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll move your bed away from the window. I have twenty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then move the moon for twenty minutes each night. I didn't leave your sofa halfway upstairs.

mechanism: A uses the completed sofa move to demand moving the moon and treats proposed lesser help as partial repayment.
confusable: Unlike simple disproportionate entitlement, A must demand an impossible act and justify it as a fair exchange for the specific past favor.
comparison: The moon alternative compares physical moving tasks and nightly duration; the time alternative asks for lost queue minutes themselves.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
